sections.section_heading: Last-click is lying, and every channel takes the credit
sections.description:
Meta says it drove the sale. Google says it did. LinkedIn says it did. Each platform reports inside its own walls, counts the same conversion, and hands you numbers that add up to more than you actually sold.

So the monthly report becomes an export from each platform, pasted into a spreadsheet, reconciled by hand, and already stale by the time anyone reads it.

sections.section_heading: Connect the channels, see one version of the truth
paragraphs: What it does
Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4, each authorised once and synced on a schedule.
One model counts each conversion once and shows which channel actually earned it, not just the one that clicked last.
Pixels, the conversions API and GA4 events are monitored, so a broken tag is flagged the day it breaks rather than at month end.
Each report ends with where budget is working and where it is not, in plain language.

paragraphs: A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

An AI-powered marketing analytics platform that unifies Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4 into one dashboard, with cross-channel attribution, signal health monitoring and campaign performance reporting.
Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4 today. Each is authorised once and synced on a schedule.
One model that counts each conversion once and shows which channel actually earned it, rather than every platform claiming the same sale inside its own walls.
A continuous check that your pixels, conversions API and GA4 events are still firing, so a broken tag is flagged the day it breaks rather than discovered at month end.
No. It recommends where budget is working and where it is not, and you decide. Nothing is changed in your ad accounts without you.
Ladder7 NextStep Solutions, which also builds Site 360, L7 Nexus, Outreach Engine and L7 Insights.

content.text: A LITTLE MORE CLARITY
Good questions.
What is Infinite Insights?–

An AI-powered marketing analytics platform that unifies Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4 into one dashboard, with cross-channel attribution, signal health monitoring and campaign performance reporting.
Which channels does it connect?+
Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and GA4 today. Each is authorised once and synced on a schedule.
What is cross-channel attribution?+
One model that counts each conversion once and shows which channel actually earned it, rather than every platform claiming the same sale inside its own walls.
What is signal health monitoring?+
A continuous check that your pixels, conversions API and GA4 events are still firing, so a broken tag is flagged the day it breaks rather than discovered at month end.
Does it move my budget for me?+
No. It recommends where budget is working and where it is not, and you decide. Nothing is changed in your ad accounts without you.
Who builds it?+
Ladder7 NextStep Solutions, which also builds Site 360, L7 Nexus, Outreach Engine and L7 Insights.
